title: plugin-webhooks: implement the declared redeliver member, read `http.server` before the `http-server` alias, and keep the self-hosted raw-app mount byte-unchanged (webhooks segment 3 of #22564's stage 2)
body:
Blocked-by: #22754

Filing gate ③: a segment the maintainer's ruling directs. Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), splitting stage 2 of #22564 (ruling 「A + 扫类」 on #22438, `6079645593` item 2) as #22438 was split (#22575–#22578). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Scope (the #22578 shape)

- `plugin-webhooks` implements the member #22754 declares, through the same service code the raw mount calls.
- **Carried from stage 1:** the producer resolves `http.server` first, then the alias, as `plugin-approvals` does (`webhook-outbox-plugin.ts` about `:389`).
- The self-hosted raw-app mount stays byte-unchanged.
- ⛔ No double mount.

## Done when

- The member answers as the raw mount does: the same refusals, the same success.
- Pins:
  - the member is called on the hosted shape;
  - the raw mount is unchanged with `http.server`.

`domain:services` · p2. It pairs with #22755; whichever lands second runs the end-to-end pin.
